name: ingles-sin-guion
description: Static site: main consultancy page, 1 Oracion al Dia app, Pangal e-sports.

comments.dependencies: Deliberately none. The site ships raw HTML, CSS and JS with no build step and no third-party JavaScript, which is also what lets the CSP stay at script-src 'self'. Adding a bundler or framework would undo that. This file exists so `npm test` and CI have a standard entry point; `npm install` installs nothing.
comments.pillow: Only needed for `npm run icons`, not for the tests.
